## Summary
- add bounded transient ReplayRequired checkpoints with deterministic forward-only reconstruction
- add scrub debounce plus generation-based cooperative cancellation
- add exact VFX transient checkpoint/restore and fixed-step forward replay
- prove seek/reconstruction state matches forward playback and update ADR 0126 implementation status

## Validation
Run the repository Windows Validation workflow for the affected scope. No Editor/Launcher visual surface changes are included, so Visual Validation is not required for this PR.
